title: Deflection and overloading
line: Pull a defender away from the square it guards, often one defender with two jobs.

steps.text: Black's queen has two jobs: she guards the rook and the knight. One piece cannot do both at once.
Tap the black piece with two jobs.
steps.after: The queen guards both black pieces.

steps.text: Pull the queen away from one job: capture the rook, with check.
steps.hint: Your rook can capture on the open file.
steps.after: The queen had to take back, and she has left the knight.

steps.text: Now the knight has no guard. Take it.
steps.after: The queen could not guard the rook and the knight at once.

summary: A defender with two jobs can do only one. Pull it away from the first, and what it guarded second falls.
